review_finding: A worker can double-fork, setsid and exec with an empty environment; after the intermediate exits, the grandchild has neither current worker lineage nor an inherited owner marker. Observed PID absence cannot prove whole-tree exit.
decision: Always refuse whole-tree continuation and owned_exit_confirmed until a separately owned, enforced kernel boundary is integrated. Preserve direct-child exit, observed-process closure and transport success as explicitly limited facts. Do not accept caller booleans or add a trusted verifier callback.
escape_regression: CPU-only worker double-fork/setsid/exec with empty env; test parent temporarily becomes a subreaper so the escaped fake process can be independently identified, signaled via pidfd and reaped without leaking a process. Show live escaped process coexists with clean observed transport closure, while continuation remains false.
constraints: New transport directory only; no real models, GPU/Q95/Comfy/unit/cloud operations. Existing pidfd cleanup identity checks and process scans remain unchanged.
verification: Focused transport suite under AS256MiB CPU30 wall45 BLAS1, sequential single-worker Ruff. Historical34-test evidence retained separately.
